title: The bird and the pup, asleep
logline: The pup asleep on the ramp in May sun and the bird on the ramp's rail above him, both still. Unsequenced on purpose: the bird's sequence doesn't take the pages where nothing happens.

panels.composition: An old three-legged dog asleep on a plank ramp in May sun with the small rainbow bird perched on the ramp's rail above it, both still.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an old three-legged dog asleep on a plank ramp in May sun with a small rainbow bird perched on the ramp's rail above it, both still, no words
